logic_node.action: Do not use dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers as HF treatment
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, dihydropyridine calcium channel-blocking drugs (e.g., amlodipine, felodipine) are not recommended as treatment for HF. They may be used for hypertension if blood pressure remains elevated despite optimization of GDMT.

source_text: In patients with HFrEF, dihydropyridine calcium channel-blocking drugs are not recommended treatment for HF. (COR 3: No Benefit, LOE A)

logic_node.action: Do not use vitamins, nutritional supplements, or hormonal therapy for HF treatment
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and hormonal therapy are not recommended other than to correct specific deficiencies. Includes vitamin D, thiamine, carnitine, taurine, coenzyme Q10, testosterone, growth hormone, and thyroid hormone.

source_text: In patients with HFrEF, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and hormonal therapy are not recommended other than to correct specific deficiencies. (COR 3: No Benefit, LOE B-R)

logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, nondihydropyridine calcium channel-blocking drugs (diltiazem and verapamil) are not recommended. They are myocardial depressants, generally not well tolerated in HF, and diltiazem was associated with higher risk of recurrent HF in HFrEF after acute MI.

source_text: In patients with HFrEF, nondihydropyridine calcium channel-blocking drugs are not recommended. (COR 3: Harm, LOE A)

logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, class IC antiarrhythmic medications (e.g., flecainide, encainide) may increase the risk of mortality. Class IC antiarrhythmic agents are generally avoided in patients with structural heart disease.

source_text: In patients with HFrEF, class IC antiarrhythmic medications and dronedarone may increase the risk of mortality. (COR 3: Harm, LOE A)

logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, dronedarone (class III antiarrhythmic) may increase the risk of mortality. In the ANDROMEDA trial, patients with HFrEF who were hospitalized had increased mortality with dronedarone.

source_text: In patients with HFrEF, class IC antiarrhythmic medications and dronedarone may increase the risk of mortality. (COR 3: Harm, LOE A)

logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, thiazolidinediones increase the risk of worsening HF symptoms and hospitalizations due to fluid retention via PPARgamma-mediated sodium reabsorption in kidney collecting ducts.

source_text: In patients with HFrEF, thiazolidinediones increase the risk of worsening HF symptoms and hospitalizations. (COR 3: Harm, LOE A)

logic_node.action: Avoid saxagliptin and alogliptin in patients with HF
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk, the DPP-4 inhibitors saxagliptin and alogliptin increase the risk of HF hospitalization and should be avoided in patients with HF. The FDA recommends discontinuation specifically of saxagliptin and alogliptin in patients who develop HF. Sitagliptin and linagliptin did not show this risk.

source_text: In patients with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk, the DPP-4 inhibitors saxagliptin and alogliptin increase the risk of HF hospitalization and should be avoided in patients with HF. (COR 3: Harm, LOE B-R)

logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, NSAIDs worsen HF symptoms and should be avoided or withdrawn whenever possible. NSAIDs inhibit renal prostaglandin synthesis, causing sodium and water retention and blunting the effects of diuretics. Both nonselective and COX-2 selective NSAIDs are associated with increased morbidity and mortality.

source_text: In patients with HFrEF, NSAIDs worsen HF symptoms and should be avoided or withdrawn whenever possible. (COR 3: Harm, LOE B-NR)

logic_node.action: Amiodarone and dofetilide are acceptable antiarrhythmics in HFrEF
logic_node.action_detail: Amiodarone and dofetilide are the only antiarrhythmic agents with neutral effects on mortality in clinical trials of patients with HFrEF. Sotalol may be used for refractory atrial-ventricular arrhythmias with close monitoring for decompensation.

source_text: Amiodarone and dofetilide are the only antiarrhythmic agents with neutral effects on mortality in clinical trials of patients with HFrEF.

logic_node.action_detail: In the SWORD trial, the class III antiarrhythmic sotalol increased mortality in patients with HF post-MI. Sotalol may be used for refractory atrial-ventricular arrhythmias with close monitoring for decompensation, but routine use is harmful.

source_text: In the SWORD trial of the class III antiarrhythmic sotalol, patients with HF post-MI had increased mortality.

logic_node.action_detail: Doxazosin (alpha-1 blocker) exacerbates underlying myocardial dysfunction and is associated with moderate magnitude of HF induction or precipitation (LOE B).

source_text: Doxazosin: exacerbates underlying myocardial dysfunction, moderate magnitude of HF induction, LOE B. Beta-1-receptor stimulation with increases in renin and aldosterone.
